title: Project G1 - 3D Anti-Gravity Tunnel Racing Engine
role: Lead Graphics & Engine Programmer (PT. T&E Simulation R&D)
summary: State-of-the-art anti-gravity space tunnel racing prototype engine written from scratch in C++ and DirectX 9 with custom HLSL shaders and procedural spline geometry.
highlights: Clean-sheet 3D rendering pipeline using DirectX 9 and custom HLSL vertex/pixel shaders.
Procedural 3D tunnel geometry generation with dynamic lighting and wireframe energy rails.
Real-time camera spline interpolation with centrifugal roll and tilt dynamics.
In-cockpit futuristic HUD displaying dynamic targeting reticles and velocity vectors.
